title: Docker Engine on Linux and when it is all you need

videos.script: On Linux there is no virtual machine to start. Docker Engine runs on the host's own kernel, and it is all a server, a pipeline or a Linux laptop needs. {{chain}} First, what happens when you type docker run. The command is only a client. It talks HTTP to a daemon, which asks containerd, which starts a small shim, which calls runc. Then runc leaves, and the shim stays with the container. {{group}} Then the installation, and the one line that matters most in it: who may talk to the daemon. Ana is in the docker group. Watch her read a folder that only root may open, through a container. That group is root, by another route. {{daemon}} And last, the daemon's own settings file. One setting in it is why this lab can pull images at all.
